purpose: Determine what backend-generated surfaces are needed so Mission Control can remain a thin controller shell and stop hardcoding workflow-specific cards.

controller_principle.attention_rule: Cards cost attention. A card should exist only when it shows current focus, explains a needed decision, presents proof requested by the operator, or gives the next playable control.

executive_summary.answer: The backend already has enough read-model evidence to drive a thin Mac renderer, but dynamic_card_packet_latest still mixes generic card structure with workflow-specific card identities and lacks a first-class card_family, normalized data-source refs, action slots, and proof/detail metadata. Dynamic card packet v1 should make card family, lifecycle, trust, proof, and controller-event actions explicit so Mac renders cards by contract instead of by workflow name.
executive_summary.current_gap: The current packet can render cards, but Mac still has to understand domain-specific card ids such as Capital Hilton payment watch, Live Arts MD evidence intake, St. Anne's work-log review, and workbook registration.
executive_summary.recommended_direction: Keep Mission Control bespoke only for shell, switching, drop zone, proof drawer, generic rendering, and safe dispatch. Move all workflow-specific card copy, visibility, proof refs, trust labels, and next controls into backend dynamic cards.
executive_summary.risk_if_not_done: Mac becomes a dashboard of special cases. Stale workflow cards will remain visible after receipts, and each new finance/build/proof lane will require app code changes.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: One current next playable control for the active lane.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Visible by default while it is the current focus; superseded immediately by a newer receipt or higher-priority needs_operator card.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Answer contextual or explanatory operator questions without staging packages by default.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Visible until answered or superseded by current focus; then collapses into History.
dynamic_card_families.trust_state: trusted_current when sourced from lane read models, preview_only when sourced from generated summary

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Keep payment lanes visible only while payment evidence is missing.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Active while payment evidence is missing; replaced by evidence-intake receipt when proof arrives; never marks paid.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Show that operator-submitted proof was recorded as candidate evidence without mutating business truth.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Waiting after intake; resolves or is superseded after classification, rejection, or ledger-review receipt.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Ask for a bounded operator decision on a protected gate without performing the protected action.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Needs operator while pending; resolved and hidden after approval/denial receipt.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Present worker/package result review controls without merge, push, or worker execution authority.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Needs operator while review_packet status is ready; hidden by default after review receipt.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Show a proposed workflow plan before any worker or business action runs.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Active only during plan review; becomes historical when staged, rejected, or superseded.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Explain why a protected action is blocked or approval-gated.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Visible only when it explains a current blocker or needed decision; otherwise developer proof only.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Let the operator review candidate memories without creating truth.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Needs operator only when approval is required; otherwise collapsed as developer proof or preference candidate.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Expose requested proof details without becoming a primary operator card.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Archived by default; shown in proof drawer or when requested by another card.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Answer deictic questions from the current world/thread instead of routing to generic diagnostics.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Short-lived active answer; collapses after context changes or a newer lane receipt supersedes it.

dynamic_card_families.purpose: Preserve receipts and historical status without taking primary attention.
dynamic_card_families.lifecycle_behavior: Resolved or archived; hidden by default under Completed / History.

lifecycle_staleness_rules: Active and needs_operator cards show by default only when they provide the next playable control.
Resolved cards hide by default after a receipt is recorded.
Historical cards collapse under Completed / History.
Stale cards must display Needs verification and name stale_reason.
Proof-only cards are hidden unless requested through details.
Workroom cards show only when operator_decision_required is true.
Finance payment-watch cards stay visible only while payment evidence is missing.
Payment-processing evidence becomes waiting evidence, not paid truth.
No card remains primary when replacement_card_ref or superseded_by_card_ref points to a newer receipt/card.
Machine-contract cards stay hidden in operator mode.

generic_actions_and_controls.rendering_rule: Mac should render enabled, disabled, and proof/detail controls from backend action payload refs. It should not synthesize workflow-specific buttons.
generic_actions_and_controls.dispatch_rule: Every mutating controller event requires a verified operator/app/device/session envelope. Incoming authority_requested is only a request; authority_granted remains backend-only.
